title: Sayad Muhammad Shahzaib
text:
# Sayad Muhammad Shahzaib

Co-Founder | Demaro Salt -- Himalayan Salt Exporter to 25+ Countries | Techviv Solutions -- AI SaaS & Digital Marketing for Global Businesses

Islāmābād, Pakistan (PK)

332 connections • 444 followers

## About

I have a story to tell you about Himalayan salt, my journey, and my experiences with computers. One day, while sitting in the office of our salt factory, I looked out the window at the hot, 45-degree weather. I saw people working hard to move big lumps of rock salt toward a machine. Those workers weren’t just random people; they were my father, my brother, and our dedicated team who have been with my father’s vision since 2002. This made me think: Does the world really know they exist? I wanted to be their voice, so I gathered my thoughts and started the journey that led to Demaro Salt. Thinking back to my childhood, I remember spending a lot of time in front of my computer. After school, I would rush home to play video games while my mother fed me. When it was time to choose my high school subjects, I picked computer studies because I was interested in it. I learned coding and discovered a whole new world beyond just playing games. I focused on coding and problem-solving, which eventually led to the creation of Techviv Solutions. Now, every morning, I wake up with two goals: 1. To share Pakistan’s Himalayan salt with the world and be proud of it. 2. To help businesses like yours get noticed and grow. Two companies. One passion. Just one curious guy from Quaidabad. If either of these interests you, my door is always open. Let’s connect!

Total Experience: 5 years

## Experience

### Co-Founder & CEO - [Demaro Salt - Manufacturer, Exporter & Supplier of Himalayan Salt from Pakistan](https://www.linkedin.com/company/demarosalt) (Current)

Aug 2021 - Present (4 years and 11 months) in Pakistan

Co-founded Demaro Salt on the foundation of my family's 23-year Himalayan salt manufacturing legacy (established 2002), transforming it into a globally recognized export brand. Lead end-to-end operations: raw salt mining, manufacturing, quality control, international logistics, export documentation, and global sales. Scaled exports to 30+ countries across North America, Europe, GCC, Australia, and Asia — serving wholesale importers, private-label brands, retail chains, and spa businesses. Built and maintain ISO, FDA, HACCP, GMP, Kosher, and Halal certifications, enabling compliant import into regulated markets including the USA, EU, and Middle East. Developed a full private-label and custom-packaging program, helping 50+ international brands launch their own Himalayan salt product lines. Expanded the product range to 200+ SKUs — salt lamps, edible salt, salt tiles, cooking slabs, animal licks, spa & wellness products. Launched a community education program covering school expenses for underprivileged children in Quaidabad, directly combating child labour in the region. Grew Demaro Salt into a company of 100+ employees, operating our own factory, export warehouse, and direct relationships with the Warcha salt mines.

Department: General Management • Level: Founder

Demaro Salt - Manufacturer, Exporter & Supplier of Himalayan Salt from Pakistan is a Food and Beverage Manufacturing company. Demaro Salt is a company specializing in the manufacturing and export of premium himalayan rock salt handicrafts. They have been serving the himalayan pink salt industry since 2002 and offer a wide range of salt products. They are responsible for premium quality prices and have a strong focus on market values. Demaro Salt - Manufacturer, Exporter & Supplier of Himalayan Salt from Pakistan has 1-10 employees (+60% YoY), founded in 2002. Headquartered in Quaidabad, Punjab, Pakistan.

### Founder - Techviv Solutions (Current)

May 2024 - Present (2 years) in Islāmābād, Pakistan
